title: A group with only 6-digit objects: OMM formats return 256 records, the TLE request returns HTTP 404

checks.description: A TLE/3LE/2LE request returns only objects with catalog numbers below 100000; if none qualify the response is HTTP 404 'No GP data found'.
The number of TLE records equals the number of OMM records whose NORAD_CAT_ID < 100000 for the same query.

NORAD_CAT_ID parses as an integer in every OMM format, including values of six and nine digits, and a ten-digit value is rejected (CCSDS allows up to nine digits); leading zeros and an explicit '+' are legal in KVN.

provides: TLE request -> 404 with body 'No GP data found' (captured twice: at 00:10Z, when a tool defect discarded the body and it was reconstructed by hand from the tool's log, D-013; and at 00:41Z as a clean re-capture with full headers, D-022)
gaps: window-dependent: once objects below 100000 re-enter the 30-day window the TLE request will return data again; the structural check covers both outcomes
